fato_historico: 1944: Soviet spy Richard Sorge, a half-Russian, half-German World War I veteran, is hanged by his Japanese captors along with 34 of his ring.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find stillness within, much like a steady bridge connecting two distant worlds. Today, consider how your hidden persistence shapes your reality. Like a quiet secret kept in the heart of nature, your resilience may bloom unexpectedly. It is a good time to trust your intuition and honor the deep, silent wisdom you carry.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the quiet persistence of a soul rooted in peace.
significado_numero: Represents the collective strength found within your inner circle of support.
conselho: Trust your internal compass and stay grounded even when shadows dance around you.
